title: Laredo Police Blue Santa 5K Run & 1-Mile Walk Set for Saturday, Dec. 5 at Sames Auto Arena
excerpt: Laredo police will hold the Blue Santa 5K Run & 1-Mile Walk on Saturday, Dec. 5, 2026, starting at 8:00 AM at Sames Auto Arena, 6700 Arena Blvd. Registration is $35 through December, $45 on race day, and $25 for the 1-mile walk. Registered participants get a free Blue Santa hat while supplies last.
content:
The Laredo Police Department is lacing up for the holidays: the Blue Santa 5K Run & 1-Mile Walk is set for Saturday, Dec. 5, 2026, starting at 8:00 AM at Sames Auto Arena, 6700 Arena Blvd.

Runners and walkers can take part in the 5K run or the 1-mile walk. Registration is $35 for November through December, $45 for race-day registration on Dec. 5, and $25 for the 1-mile walk in any registration period. Early registration at $25 ran through October.

Registered participants will receive a free Blue Santa hat, while supplies last.

Participants are also asked to bring an unwrapped toy or a monetary donation to benefit the Blue Santa Toy Drive, the department's annual holiday toy program for children in the community.

The event runs from 8:00 AM to 1:00 PM. To register, scan the code on the department's flyer or visit laredopd.com/bluesanta5k.

Source: Laredo Police Department, Nov. 16, 2026; City of Laredo, Blue Santa 5K Run event listing.
